name: Insight Molecular Diagnostics I
business_overview: Insight Molecular Diagnostics Inc. operates as a precision diagnostics company in the United States and internationally. The company develops and commercializes laboratory developed tests, kitted research use only tests, and kitted clinical tests. It is developing DetermaCNI, a blood-based monitoring tool that detects progression early after one cycle cancer treatment; and DetermaIO, a gene expression test that assesses the tumor microenvironment to predict response to immunotherapies. The company also offers GraftAssureCore test, a blood test designed to measure dd-cfDNA using a novel PCR-based measurement platform, for potential patient registrants; GraftAssureIQ, a transplant monitoring assay to measure the donor-derived cell-free DNA; and GraftAssureDx, a decentralized transplant monitoring levels of donor-derived cell-free DNA in plasma following kidney transplantation to aid in the assessment of the probability of allograft rejection at the time of testing in conjunction with standard clinical assessments. In addition, it provides testing services for biomarker discovery, assay design and development, clinical trial support, and various biomarker tests. The company has a collaboration agreement with Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. for the development and commercialization of research use only and in vitro diagnostics kitted transplant products using Bio-Rad's ddPCR instruments and reagents. The company was formerly known as OncoCyte Corporation and changed its name to Insight Molecular Diagnostics Inc. in June 2025. Insight Molecular Diagnostics Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Nashville, Tennessee.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Insight Molecular (IMDX) is building early momentum for its GraftAssure kidney transplant monitoring assay ahead of a regulatory catalyst. Research-use‑only kit sales have begun in Europe and an Asia‑Pacific order is imminent, while the company signed its first U.S. clinical‑trial agreement with a top‑10 transplant center for the GALACTIC registry, signaling institutional engagement. The FDA dialogue remains encouraging, with authorization expected later in 2026, which could unlock significant U.S. orders. Current lab‑service revenue is negligible, but pre‑approval demand and the planting of real‑world evidence infrastructure suggest a nascent product cycle that hinges on regulatory clearance and clinical adoption in transplant centers.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is concentrating resources on bringing GraftAssure to market, securing a $26 million funding round to extend the runway through the anticipated approval. The launch of the GALACTIC registry demonstrates a deliberate effort to generate post‑market data for physician confidence. Insider activity is notably constructive—solely purchases, no sales in recent months—underscoring internal conviction. Management’s posture is proactive, having already lined up interested centers and early kit shipments; credibility will ultimately be tested by the timing of FDA authorization and the pace of conversion from research use to routine clinical adoption.

We successfully recommended Imdex (ASX:IMD) late last year in The Dynamic Investor. Earlier last month, the shares retraced from all-time highs after the prices for gold and copper fell. Together, these two commodities comprise ~75% of exploration spend.

The sell-off prompted us to revisit the fundamentals. Our most recent review in The Dynamic Investor also included an assessment of results for the six months to 31 December 2025 (1H26). With the share price recovering steadily, do current levels still present an attractive entry opportunity?
